A Booth Level Officer (BLO) verifies voter details during the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls, in New Delhi, Tuesday, June 30, 2026. Workers of the Jammu and Kashmir Peoples Democratic Party (PDP) raise slogans during a protest against the government, in Jammu, Jammu and Kashmir, on June 30. (Credit: PTI)
Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis being presented a memento by Andhra Pradesh Deputy CM Pawan Kalyan during a meeting, at the CM's official residence, in Mumbai. The image was released on June 30. (Credit: @PawanKalyan/X via PTI)
Activist Sonam Wangchuk during an indefinite hunger strike at the Jantar Mantar protest by the Cockroach Janata Party (CJP) to press for Union Education Minister Dharmendra Pradh's resignation over alleged examination irregularities, in New Delhi on June 30. (Credit: PTI)

    H1N1 cases: Why the flu wave could linger longer in Bengaluru than in Delhi
    Lifestyle28 min ago

    Experts warn of prolonged H1N1 transmission in Bengaluru due to its mild climate and seasonal patterns, providing a longer window for spread compared to Delhi. Indoor crowding during the monsoon season can worsen the outbreak. Early recognition and isolation of symptomatic individuals are crucial. Look out for sudden fever, cough, and other symptoms.
